rawContent: #feminist is still rather new concept to Japanese. Even after the world’s big #MeToo Movement. It is not about women barking at men or sexual preference. Nor how to dress. It is about human rights. Every country go through the “wake” era. Education is the key

We shouldn’t criticise the people who are being sensitive over #metoo we should be criticising the people who don’t understand unless educating them super sensitively. Until they understand, no choice but to be sensitive. Can’t risk ppl safety over entertainment
